floater.name: floater_ss_atmo_sky_import
floater.title: Import EEP Sky
floater.text: The dropped sky's values become keyframes at the preview head. Choose which parts of it to take.

check_box.name: import_atmosphere
check_box.tool_tip: Blue horizon and density, haze horizon and density, sky moisture, droplet radius, ice level, density and distance multipliers, max altitude.
check_box.label: Atmosphere - haze, density, sky ceiling

check_box.name: import_lighting
check_box.tool_tip: Ambient and sunlight colour, scene gamma, reflection probe ambiance, and the sun and moon glow size and focus.
check_box.label: Lighting - colours, gamma, sun glow

check_box.name: import_celestial
check_box.tool_tip: Star brightness and moon brightness only.
check_box.label: Celestial - star and moon brightness

check_box.name: import_sun
check_box.tool_tip: The sky's sun disc becomes this track's standard sun body: its disc scale sets the body's diameter at its current orbit, and a custom sun texture replaces the body's. Offered only while the sun is still the standard one.
check_box.label: Sun - resize and retexture the standard sun body

check_box.name: import_moon
check_box.tool_tip: The sky's moon disc becomes this track's standard moon body: its disc scale sets the body's diameter at its current orbit, and a custom moon texture replaces the body's. Offered only while the moon is still the standard one.
check_box.label: Moon - resize and retexture the standard moon body

check_box.name: import_clouds
check_box.tool_tip: The legacy Windlight cloud plane's whole parameter set: colour, coverage, scale, variance, scroll rate, density and detail, noise texture.
check_box.label: Clouds - the legacy dome layer
